voice.title: Voice tutor
voice.switchWarning: Starting the Tutor will end your live Book agent conversation.
voice.activity.retrying: The tutor is busy — trying again…
voice.activity.fallback: The tutor is busy — switching to a backup…
voice.activity.retryingN: The tutor is busy — trying again (attempt {attempt|n})…
voice.steps.label: What the tutor did
voice.notice.micTyping: The microphone didn't open, so the tutor stayed in typing mode.
voice.notice.typingUnavailable: Couldn't switch back to typing — the voice tutor is still answering.
voice.notice.replyFailed: The tutor's reply failed — please ask again.
voice.hint.missing: The writing and voice tutor currently require {provider|ltr}. Connect {provider|ltr} to start.
voice.hint.locked: Your {provider|ltr} key vault is locked. Unlock it to start the tutor.
voice.hint.error: Could not check {provider|ltr} access. Check again or open {provider|ltr} setup.
voice.noNarrationHint: No narration for this book yet — you can still talk with the tutor; playback controls arrive with its first cast.
voice.standaloneHint: No book attached — a live tutor for anything you want to learn.
voice.transcriptEmpty: Your conversation appears here as you speak or type.
voice.approxHint: Approximate — this is what the tutor heard, transcribed by the provider.
voice.how.muted: Muted: the tutor cannot hear you. Unmute to talk, or type.
voice.how.interactive: Interactive: the tutor hears your mic between its replies and speaks aloud — the mic pauses itself while audio plays; use Interrupt to cut in, Mute to stay silent, or type.
voice.how.audio: The tutor speaks aloud and drives playback and the live preview; the transcript carries every word. Go interactive to talk, or type to ask.
voice.how.text: Typing: the tutor writes its answers, in detail, and drives playback and the live preview. Go interactive to talk by voice.
voice.clipboardUnavailable: No clipboard access in this window.
voice.notice.adopted: Rejoined the voice session that was already running — earlier turns are not shown here.
voice.notice.noAudioOut: No audio output device — the tutor answers in text.
voice.notice.audioLost: Audio output was lost — continuing in text.
voice.notice.noMic: No microphone — type to ask instead.
voice.notice.micLost: The microphone was lost — continuing without it.
voice.notice.navigatedNoPage: Reached a position with no page this reader can show.
voice.clone.title: Clone a voice
voice.clone.needsModelTitle: Voice cloning needs one more download
voice.clone.needsModelDetail: Voice cloning learns a voice from a short sample. It is a {size|ltr} download and runs on this computer — nothing is uploaded.
voice.clone.recordPrompt: Read this aloud in your normal speaking voice, as if you were reading a book:
voice.clone.recordScript: The harbour was quiet that morning. A grey light came over the water, and the boats moved a little with the tide, waiting for the wind to change.
voice.clone.name: Name
voice.clone.consentNote: Only clone a voice you own or have permission to use.
voice.clone.watermarkNote: Audio made with a cloned voice carries an inaudible watermark that marks it as synthetic.
voice.clone.warnLong: That recording ran long, so only the first minute was kept. Cloning uses the first {n|n} seconds of it.
voice.clone.warnMax: Cloning uses the first {n|n} seconds — the rest is ignored.
voice.clone.nameEmpty: Give this voice a name so you can find it later.
voice.clone.nameTaken: You already have a voice with that name.
voice.preview.label: Preview
voice.clone.err.tooShort: That sample is too short. Record or import at least 3 seconds of speech.
voice.clone.err.engineNotReady: Voice cloning isn't ready yet — try again in a moment.
voice.clone.err.noRecording: No recording is running. Press Record to start one.
voice.clone.err.sampleGone: That sample is no longer available. Record or import it again.
voice.clone.err.noInputs: No microphone was found on this computer — you can import an audio file instead.
voice.clone.err.generic: Voice cloning couldn't finish. Try again, or import a different file.
voice.mode.typeHint: Written answers, with detail and page links.
voice.now.mutedSub: Unmute when you want to talk
voice.now.speakingSub: Your mic waits until it finishes
voice.now.reconnectingSub: Your mic waits until it's back
voice.peek.label: Pages the tutor read
voice.peek.empty: This page has no text to show.
voice.hint.unavailable: No {provider|ltr} key is currently usable. Check disabled keys, key errors, or rate limits in {provider|ltr} setup.
voice.alignAdvisory: This voice has no word timing, and no alignment model is installed. Read-along highlighting will follow sentences.
voice.notice.navigationNotApplied: The reader could not open the tutor’s page. Try again or choose another page.
voice.return.elsewhere: A conversation is still running in another context.
voice.return.unavailable: The conversation is still running, but its book or cast cannot be opened. You can end the session here.
voice.return.failed: Could not return to the conversation. Try again.
voice.recovery.limit: Leaving this page keeps the conversation running. Reloading the screen may hide earlier messages. After restarting the app, use Past sessions to continue saved conversations. Conversations set to Never persist cannot be recovered after restart.
